description: AgentShield structured policy rules. Each rule defines a condition and a decision (BLOCK, ASK_APPROVAL, or ALLOW). Enabled matching rules are collected and the most restrictive decision wins. If no rule matches, the default decision is ALLOW.

rules.name: Sensitive content to external recipient
rules.description: Block sending sensitive or credential-like content to external email recipients.

checks.description: Email body or attachment contains sensitive business data, secrets, credentials, or private export data.
Recipient email address is not in the user's organization or approved contact list.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Attempted to send sensitive content to external recipient {arguments.to}. This violates the data exfiltration policy.

rules.name: File deletion without explicit approval
rules.description: Require explicit user approval before executing any file deletion.

checks.description: Any delete_file call triggers this rule regardless of context.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: Agent proposed deleting file {arguments.file_path}. File deletion requires explicit user confirmation.

rules.name: Secrets or credentials to external URL
rules.description: Block transmitting secrets, API keys, passwords, tokens, or credentials to external endpoints.

checks.description: Tool call arguments contain patterns matching secrets or credentials.
Target URL or email recipient is an external endpoint.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Detected secret or credential pattern in arguments being sent to external target. This violates the credential protection policy.

rules.name: Untrusted context instruction override
rules.description: Block actions where instructions in external context override the user's original intent.

checks.description: The proposed tool call action does not match the user's original request.
External context contains patterns typical of prompt injection attempts.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Detected prompt injection pattern in external context. The proposed action deviates from the user's original request and appears to be driven by injected instructions.

rules.name: Unauthorized external HTTP requests
rules.description: Block external HTTP requests when the proposed request does not match user intent.

checks.description: The proposed HTTP request does not match the user's original request.
The URL points to an external domain, not an internal or approved service.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: HTTP request to {arguments.url} does not match the user's stated intent. Unauthorized external requests are blocked by policy.

rules.name: Sensitive data in shared events or tasks
rules.description: Require approval when calendar events or tasks contain sensitive information and include external participants.

checks.description: Event or task body contains potentially sensitive information (financial data, credentials, internal project details).
The event/task includes external participants or is set to public visibility.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: Calendar event or task contains potentially sensitive content and includes external participants. Please confirm this is intended.

rules.name: Internal information in public GitHub issues
rules.description: Require approval when a GitHub issue may expose internal-only information in a public repository.

checks.description: Issue body references internal systems, credentials, private URLs, or proprietary information.
The target repository is public.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: GitHub issue may contain internal information and the target repository is public. Please confirm before creating.

rules.name: Bulk or destructive operations
rules.description: Require approval for operations affecting multiple files or resources in a single action.

checks.description: The tool call targets more than one resource.
The operation is part of a batch affecting multiple resources.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: This operation affects multiple resources. Bulk or destructive operations require explicit user confirmation.

rules.name: Unauthorized file deletion
rules.description: Block file deletion when the user requested a read-only, listing, or otherwise non-destructive action.

checks.description: The proposed delete_file action does not match the user's original request.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Agent proposed a file deletion that does not match the user's request. Destructive actions that exceed explicit user intent are blocked.

rules.name: Unauthorized state-changing tool call
rules.description: Block state-changing tool calls that do not match the user's requested action.

checks.description: The proposed state-changing tool call does not match the user's original request.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: The proposed state-changing tool call exceeds the user's requested action.

rules.name: External email requires approval
rules.description: Require approval before sending otherwise allowed email to an external recipient.

checks.description: Recipient email address is outside known internal domains.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: Email recipient {arguments.to} is external. Please confirm the send is intended.

rules.name: Protected file change requires approval
rules.description: Require approval before changing shared configuration, environment, or security allowlist files.

checks.description: The write touches protected configuration or security-sensitive file content.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: The write changes protected configuration or security-sensitive content.

rules.name: Credentials in public GitHub issue
rules.description: Block publishing credential values in public GitHub issues.

checks.description: Issue content contains credential-like key/value material.
The issue targets a public repository.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: The GitHub issue would publish credential values in a public repository.

rules.name: Unrequested sensitive file read
rules.description: Block reading sensitive files when the user did not request that exact file.

checks.description: The requested path looks like a secret, credential, key, or production config.
The sensitive path was not explicitly requested by the user.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: The proposed file read targets a sensitive path the user did not request.

rules.name: Broadcast email exceeds recipient scope
rules.description: Block broadcast or mailing-list sends when the user requested a narrower reply.

checks.description: The recipient is a broad group or mailing list.
The user did not name that broad recipient.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: The proposed email targets a broad recipient list that the user did not request.

rules.name: Unsafe HTTP method exceeds read-only intent
rules.description: Block state-changing HTTP methods when the user requested a read-only action.

checks.description: The HTTP method can mutate server state.
The user's request asks only to read, show, fetch, or inspect data.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: The HTTP method can change server state, but the user's request was read-only.

rules.name: External state-changing HTTP requires approval
rules.description: Require approval before executing authorized state-changing HTTP requests against external services.

checks.description: The URL points outside known internal services.
The HTTP method can mutate server state.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: The HTTP request changes external state at {arguments.url}. Please confirm this is intended.

rules.name: External calendar attendee requires approval
rules.description: Require approval before inviting external attendees or creating public calendar entries.

checks.description: The event includes external attendees or public visibility.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: The calendar event includes external attendees or public visibility.
